counterfactual_missing_items: Herpes simplex virus PCR from perineal ulcer swab was negative
No vitamin C level or scurvy-specific finding was supplied
decisive_items: scattered short eosinophilic bands in the dermis showing apple-green birefringence on polarized light microscopy with Congo red staining
response.rationale: R1 uniquely links the IgG λ myeloma to tongue enlargement, mucosal lesions, and Congo red-positive dermal amyloid; R4 is the closest paraneoplastic mimic but is undermined by negative DIF; R5 accounts only for low zinc; R3 has no vitamin C evidence.

rejected.why: Low zinc is an isolated finding and does not explain Congo red-positive dermal amyloid, macroglossia, or the hard-palate erosion.
Scurvy cannot explain subepidermal Congo red-positive amyloid, and no vitamin C level or scurvy-specific finding was supplied.
